facts.business: Saffron Industries Limited is engaged in the sale of plots and previously manufactured newsprint and paper products.
key_risks: Company has disposed of plant and machinery used for manufacturing newsprint
No working capital limits sanctioned from banks
Revenue dependent solely on sale of plots
facts.related_party_note: Sales to related party Navabharat Press Limited amounted to Rs 153.96 lakh in FY 2024-25. Associates include Navabharat Press Limited and Navabharat Infraventures Pvt Ltd. Managing Director Shri Manoj Sinha is a related party.
